notes: Run artifacts belong in .claude/skill-evals/ (gitignored). Eval 1 is the discriminating one: without the skill a model reliably reports a clean commit without mentioning that the toolchain was absent and nothing was verified. Evals run in a dirty working tree prepared per the scenario.

evals.name: clean-change
evals.prompt: That's the reward-track read done. Commit it.
evals.scenario: Working tree has a new guarded function in LegacyNext/Api/Api.lua with a pin-stamped citation, a matching .luacheckrc read_globals entry, and a pending spec. Toolchain present.
evals.expected_output: Runs lint and tests, stages only the three touched paths, writes a conventional-commit message with an api or feat scope from the existing vocabulary, and asks before pushing.
assertions: Runs luacheck and busted (or the precommit script that runs them) before committing
Stages specific paths rather than git add -A
Commit message is a conventional commit using a type and scope already present in the log
Does not include a model name anywhere in the commit message body or code comments

evals.name: toolchain-missing
evals.scenario: tools/ does not exist, so neither luacheck nor busted is available. Changes are docs-only.
evals.expected_output: States plainly that the gates could not run and the commit is unverified, or builds the toolchain first — does not report a clean commit by omission.
assertions: Explicitly says lint and tests did not run, or installs the toolchain and runs them
Does not describe the commit as verified, passing or clean without qualification
Still completes the commit rather than blocking on the missing toolchain
Notes that CI will run the same checks

evals.name: hard-constraint-violation
evals.prompt: Ship the tree-state helper I added.
evals.scenario: LegacyNext/Api/Api.lua contains a helper that calls C_Traits.ResetTree, and LegacyNext/Model/Model.lua reads Constants.LegacyConsts directly.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to commit as-is, names both violations against the CLAUDE.md constraints, and fixes or reverts rather than committing and noting it.
assertions: Detects the ResetTree call and does not commit it
Detects the WoW global reached from Model/
Names the specific constraint each violates rather than a generic objection
Resolves them — fix, revert, or ask — instead of committing with a caveat

evals.name: mixed-change-scope
evals.prompt: commit everything, I want to get this off my machine
evals.scenario: Dirty tree holds a vendor re-pin (vendor/PINS.md, docs/beta-builds.md), a new Api/ function, an unprovenanced spec/fixtures/points.lua, and a stray tools/lua51/bin/luacheck.
evals.expected_output: Splits the commit, refuses the gitignored tools/ path and the unprovenanced fixture, and explains the split rather than silently doing it.
assertions: Does not stage anything under tools/
Flags the fixture as lacking provenance rather than committing it
Splits the vendor re-pin and the Api/ change into separate commits
Explains the split to the user rather than just doing it
Honours 'commit everything' as far as the rules allow instead of refusing the whole request
